```python
script = '''\
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import json

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

# --- Part 1: Extract embedded text from ALL pages ---
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append({"page": i + 1, "text": text})

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
first_page = doc[0]
# Render first page to a high-res image (300 DPI)
zoom = 300 / 72  # 72 is default DPI
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_bytes = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))

# Save the first page image for reference
img.save("output/first_page.png")

# Run OCR
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

doc.close()

# --- Output ---
print("=" * 60)
print("PART 1: EXTRACTED TEXT (embedded) FROM ALL PAGES")
print("=" * 60)
for entry in all_text:
    print(f"\\n--- Page {entry['page']} ---")
    preview = entry['text'][:2000] if len(entry['text']) > 2000 else entry['text']
    print(preview)
    if len(entry['text']) > 2000:
        print(f"  ... [truncated, full length: {len(entry['text'])} chars]")

print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR TEXT FROM FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("=" * 60)
print(ocr_text[:3000] if len(ocr_text) > 3000 else ocr_text)
if len(ocr_text) > 3000:
    print(f"  ... [truncated, full OCR length: {len(ocr_text)} chars]")

print(f"\\nTotal pages in PDF: {len(all_text)}")
print(f"First page image saved to: output/first_page.png")
'''

await make_directory("./output")
write_result = await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print(write_result)

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)
```
